title: Signal in the Snow
logline: Two radio operators at a polar listening post decode a signal that should not exist.
brief: Two radio operators at a polar listening post decode a signal that shouldn't exist; each episode ends further out on the ice, one character per episode gets closer to it
style: Cold blue-white cinematic realism with warm lamp accents, 35mm grain.
arc_summary: Ep 1: Elias is gone, but the signal has locked onto his location, pulling the remaining operator, Mara, toward the coordinates where the ice begins to hum in response. | Ep 2: The membrane reveals a submerged structure beneath the ice, and Mara's radio crackles with a voice that is unmistakably Elias's, telling her to stop moving forward because the signal is no longer coming from the post, but from inside the structure itself. | Ep 3: The machine has fully activated, broadcasting the signal across the globe, and the final shot holds on the empty radio post back at the surface, where a new pair of operators sits in silence, waiting for the next impossible call.
